messages:
sam: heads-up: attempted to cut a patch for samplekit and the publish pipeline stopped me — regendiff shows API shim removed and changelog bumped unexpectedly.
ci-bot: publish job 1183 blocked: regendiff mismatch -> https://ci.redwood.example/1183
alexa: paste the diff?
sam: short: ```diff
- export function sendWithRetry(req: Req, retries?: number): Promise<Resp>
+ export function send(req: Req): Promise<Resp>
```
nora: that shim (sendWithRetry) was a generated compatibility alias. new codegen inlined retry middleware which removed the alias => semver tooling flagged it as API removal.
jen: semver bot logic: exported symbol removal triggers at least a minor bump; changelog-generator marked it as breaking in the SDK changelog. That's causing downstream sample apps to want version bumps.
alexa: quick unblock: add a temporary compatibility shim in templates so regen output keeps alias. small PR to codegen templates should make regendiff empty.
sam: confirmed local repro with `yarn typegen:regen --spec=samplekit && git diff`. shim makes diff clean.
jen: filing issue: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/issues/1533 "codegen: preserve generated compatibility aliases by default" (labels: sdk-parity, semver-risk). assigning @alexa.
nora: long-term we should also: 1) surface regendiff in Console UI, 2) have publish tool require manual semver confirmation on API removals, 3) auto-generate compat shims when a removal is detected and propose them as PR suggestions.
typegen-bot: regendiff artifact for job 1183: https://artifacts.redwood/1183/regendiff.txt
alexa: I'll open hotfix PR to reintroduce the shim and add a unit test that checks public API set equality post-regen.
sam: also noticed nondet overload ordering on Windows causing churn; proposing a small canonical-sort step after regen: `node scripts/normalize-api-order.js`.
jen: good. add changelog-generator tweak to ignore pure reorderings (same signature set) so we don't bump semver for ordering noise.
nora: small onboarding note: added to samplekit/CONTRIBUTING.md: "run `yarn typegen:preview` and inspect regendiff artifact before bumping versions".
alexa: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2299 1 - adds shim + api-set snapshot + canonical-sort step. tagging @jen @sam for review.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by PR 2299. regendiff now clean on preview.
nora: once merged, follow-up: add a publish-gate that fails if regendiff shows removed exported symbols without a human confirmation checkbox in the PR.
jen: agreed. adding to release checklist and the SDK stability epic. thanks all :heart:
